response.sql: WITH race_stats AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) as avg_points, COUNT(*) as field_size FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) as avg_fs FROM race_stats), filtered AS (SELECT avg_points, field_size FROM race_stats WHERE field_size > (SELECT avg_fs FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(avg_points), AVG(field_size), AVG(field_size) - (SELECT avg_fs FROM overall_avg) FROM filtered
